host_type: 16-vCPU cloud host (AMD Ryzen 9 9950X), 31 GiB RAM, /dev/kvm present, local docker daemon; one host for every workload of this study, run one after another
scope: Whole-host samples, including this study's own builds, seeding, snapshots, harness containers and measured work. load1 is the one-minute load average; cpu_pct is top(1) percent of one logical CPU for the four busiest processes at that instant.
other_processes: Processes that are not part of this study (the host's own management and monitoring agents, kernel threads) are recorded as 'other'.

hosts.work: image load, checkouts, the two release builds (built in parallel)
seeding, baseline snapshot, four-query replays of both arms, default-spill target and repeat
four benchmark/run.ts runs: baseline, candidate, baseline, candidate
candidate repeat on the retained replica, refused baseline repeat, second replica and its three arms
